headline: Claude-Mem Gives Coding Agents A Past
lede: Claude-Mem turns scattered sessions into an indexed project history. Lifecycle hooks capture activity, SQLite stores the record, and hybrid retrieval brings the right context back when an agent needs it.

headline: Lightpanda Rebuilds The Browser For Agents
lede: Lightpanda strips browser automation down to a Zig-native core built for speed and low memory use. CDP, WebDriver BiDi, MCP, and deterministic scripts give crawlers and agents a compact execution layer.

headline: Kronos Forecasts Markets In Discrete Tokens
lede: Kronos converts OHLCV sequences into hierarchical tokens, then models them with autoregressive Transformers. Its compact and base checkpoints make forecasting, fine-tuning, and backtesting accessible without training from zero.

headline: T3 Code Puts Coding Agents On Every Screen
lede: T3 Code wraps Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other tools in one control surface for web, desktop, and mobile. The result is a polished remote cockpit that keeps execution tied to the developer’s own machine.

headline: OpenMausBot Builds A Local Team Of Agents
lede: OpenMausBot keeps agent teams, transcripts, credentials, and approvals close to home. Its permission broker makes shell commands, file changes, and connected services deliberate acts rather than invisible automation.

headline: Public APIs Maps The Open Interface Economy
lede: More than 2,000 free APIs are cataloged by purpose, authentication, HTTPS support, and CORS availability. The directory turns scattered integration knowledge into a searchable reference—and now extends its shelves to MCP servers.

headline: Handy Turns Speech Into Local Text
lede: Handy uses a global shortcut to capture speech, transcribe it offline, and paste the result wherever the cursor sits. Whisper, Parakeet, GPU acceleration, and command-line controls keep the workflow fast and firmly on the desktop.

headline: Claude Code Runs A Full Game Studio
lede: This playful but rigorous experiment assigns Claude Code 49 specialized agents across design, engineering, art, audio, QA, and release. Hooks, templates, and scoped rules turn a single session into a repeatable production process.

headline: Kornia Makes Computer Vision Differentiable
lede: Kornia brings more than 1,200 vision and geometry operators directly into PyTorch tensors. Batched GPU execution, gradients through transformations, and export paths connect image processing to modern spatial-AI pipelines.

headline: AiSOC Makes Security Automation Auditable
lede: AiSOC routes telemetry through Kafka, detection rules, correlation, and AI-assisted investigation in a self-hosted operations center. Its Investigation Ledger records every decision, while approval pauses keep playbooks under human control.
